mainEntity.name: How do you match the existing stucco texture and color?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching existing stucco texture and color is a critical part of a successful patch. For texture, our skilled craftsmen use various tools and techniques, such as troweling, spraying, or hand-texturing, to replicate the original finish, whether it's smooth, sand, dash, or another style. For color, we often take samples of your existing stucco to custom-tint the new material. This might involve using a base color with pigment additives or staining the patch after it cures to ensure a near-perfect blend with the surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: We match stucco texture using specific tools and application techniques. For color, we custom-tint new material based on existing stucco samples, sometimes staining the patch after curing for a seamless blend.
